name: Hypnosis for eye color change

lead: Hypnosis for eye colour change is a claim, found in fringe corners of appearance culture, that hypnosis, self-hypnosis or suggestion recordings can alter the colour of the irises, offering a different eye colour with no lenses or surgery.

Wikipedia describes hypnosis as a state of focused attention and heightened suggestibility and reports no evidence that it alters physical characteristics such as body structure or appearance. Research there shows suggestion can affect sensation, perception and some involuntary responses. No published studies tested hypnosis for eye colour.

paras: People follow courses, recordings or self-hypnosis sessions that pair relaxation with imagery of a new eye colour, repeated over an extended period.
No direct physical harms are documented. Money spent on courses or recordings is the main reported cost, and sudden real changes in eye colour can accompany medical conditions.

angle.text: Fringe corners of appearance culture claim hypnosis or suggestion recordings can shift iris pigment and give a different eye colour. No studies have tested it, and reference sources report no evidence that hypnosis changes physical traits.

lead: Hypnosis for eye color change is a claim, found in fringe corners of appearance culture, that hypnosis, self-hypnosis or suggestion recordings can alter the color of a person's irises.

Wikipedia describes hypnosis as a state of focused attention and heightened suggestibility and reports no evidence that it alters physical characteristics such as body structure or appearance [1]. Research cited there shows suggestion can affect sensation, perception and some involuntary responses, and that brain imaging changes under suggestion may reflect stronger imagination rather than real perceptual change [1].
No published studies were found that tested hypnosis for changing eye color.

paras: Proponents of such methods say that the mind can change physical features through suggestion. Marketed recordings and courses of this type are described in community discussion; no specific products are listed here.

Wikipedia notes that the effectiveness of hypnotherapy has not been accurately assessed, that major bodies such as the UK National Health Service classify it as alternative medicine, and that its article contains no evidence of hypnosis changing physical traits [1].

Eye color is described as determined largely by iris pigmentation. Documented natural changes occur in infancy and from adolescence to adulthood, and medical causes include certain drugs and diseases [2].

lore.intro: The idea circulates as a fringe method alongside other non-surgical eye color claims.

claims.claim: Hypnosis or suggestion can change your eye color
